title: Performance assurance fingerprint omits the active versioned campaign

source_observation.environment: Clean-head schema-4 no-reuse planner comparison across MIR3-TERM-0009 on Windows dev
source_observation.fact: runtime.performance-regression retained fingerprint 132932D91E374E17BB12F5A8E21FF309E09FDDC140BFC7E6752A8426902E7D1B before and after .mir/performance-campaigns/3.2.5-C32.json changed from Factorio 2.1.12 to 2.1.13.

reproducer.expected: Changing the exact active versioned performance campaign changes performance.static and runtime.performance-regression input fingerprints; changing an unrelated historical campaign does not.
reproducer.observed: The catalog fingerprinted only the root 3.2.2 calibration file, while the runtime producer selected and overlaid the exact 3.2.5-C32 versioned authority later; the planned runtime fingerprint therefore remained unchanged across the authority correction.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; package-excluded evidence-reuse fingerprint selection only

regression_obligations: performance fingerprints bind the immutable root calibration and exact active versioned campaign
active versioned campaign changes invalidate reusable performance evidence

fixed_point_restart_scope: all performance and aggregate assurance proofs admitted through the corrected fingerprint policy; no package shadow restart

admission.reason: The unsafe reuse gap is reproduced, bounded to package-excluded input selection, and correctable without changing product source or package bytes.
